en: Damn it! Were we too late? What the hell is the Empire thinking?!
We were too late... But still... this is too cruel... What is the Empire trying to do?!
No! Were we too late?! The Empire's invasion... it's like history repeating itself...
This is... horrible... we were too late... But why did the Empire begin this invasion...?
We have the Demon Stone... Now, I leave the rest to you.
The one leading this army is Alberic... That man... I won't forgive him...
Ngh, no matter how many I defeat... this is getting me nowhere...
You can't take on this whole army alone any longer. Let us fall back for now.
Alberic... I have to stop that man...
If I don't do it, who else... will protect the Empire's honor...
Please calm down!{n}
Let's wait for a chance.{n}
It's impossible, Leyla. Please calm down.
Their tyranny is driving the Empire, and the world, mad! If I don't stop it here...
Please, Leyla. I cannot afford to lose you here.
...All right. For now, I'll listen to you.
...Alberic, I swear I'll stop you...
Leyla, let us wait for a chance. Fighting on now would be reckless.
A chance...?
Yes. A chance to get close to him again is sure to come.
All right... for now, I'll trust your words...
General Kaiser
You're late, Leyla Vigrid.
General Kaiser! Is it true that you killed my men?
Yes, it is. But you are now a traitor to our nation. The Emperor ordered that anyone who aids you be killed.
As a knight, I merely obeyed his will. To defy an order for personal feelings is out of the question!
Surely you've realized too that the Kreutzfelds, father and son, framed me!
And your superior now, Alberic, is no one who deserves to be called a knight!
But Lord Alberic was appointed commander by the Emperor. The commander's orders are the Emperor's orders.
No! The whole country knows the young Emperor does whatever the Kreutzfelds tell him!
Your friendship and trust with my father... I always respected you, who fought through so many wars by his side.
And yet, General Kaiser... won't you listen to what I have to say?
The duty of us knights is always to serve as the Emperor's hands and feet.
Do you not see how foolish it is for us, his hands and feet, to question the Emperor's will?
Enough idle talk. As an imperial knight, I have orders to kill you. You are my dear friend's daughter, but orders are absolute.
Now, draw your sword!
You didn't fight me in earnest...
No... that's not so. You are simply splendid... A strong sword full of spirit, very like your father's...
Your men were young, able knights. I am sorry that I robbed them of their futures...
General Kaiser...
But my convictions, from long years as an imperial knight, are absolute... I live as a knight, and die as a knight...
Farewell...
Emperor
Kreutzfeld isn't here? Then now, the Emperor...!!
Leyla!
Well, Leyla... lovely as ever, even like that...
But... you'd best refrain from anything so dangerous.
Assassinating the Emperor is out of the question...
It saddens me to judge one as lovely as you for treason, but if I don't cut you down here, you'll likely escape again...
You seem to have a great many helpers, after all.
Leyla! I'll show myself...!!
Hold, Alberic.
We will not have this victory celebration stained with blood.
She offers no resistance. Carry out her punishment another day...
Yes, Your Majesty...
You're Viper, aren't you?
Hey now, when you ask somebody something, ain't it polite to give your own name first?
I have no name to give a thief. Return the Demon Stone at once.
You ain't on my side? I figured you were, what with you wearing an imperial uniform.
So you're a traitor, then.
That's none of your concern. Besides, the Empire now isn't the proud nation I know.
Now, enough chatter. If you won't hand it over, I'll take it by force!
Whoa, whoa, don't make such a scary face. I ain't good at fighting.
If you put it like that, fine. An empire that's got troublemakers like you in it... I bet it'd use this Demon Stone for something shady too.
There, I'll give it back! To the angel, that is.
Who are you...?
I am Diana, guardian of this Forest of Reyforia.
My name is Leyla Vigrid.
You did well to find your way here. No one but the blessed can enter this place.
The blessed?
Yes... that's right.
When signs of chaos appear in the world, children of man are blessed and guided. By the Angel...
Evil shadows now swirl through this world. So you too, as one guided by the Angel, must hold to a strong will.
For the enemy preys on weak hearts that waver and worry.
Do you know who is throwing this world into chaos?
No. What the Angel does not know, no person could know.
But I am reminded of the legend of the Empire's founding emperor. Of the Heavenly Dragon born from the Demon Stone of Delphinia...
The Heavenly Dragon...
I cannot leave this land, but here I will protect something precious.
But my heart is always with all of you. Leyla... please be careful...
Yes... thank you for speaking with me.
You!
Leyla... please protect the world. And please be a help to the Angel...
Was I too late?!
Ngh... if only I'd gotten here sooner...
Leyla... it's you... I've missed you...
Let's settle this... fair and square, as fellow knights.
You'd best not... you cannot beat my sword...
No... I will not lose to you...
Why are you... always so stubborn...
I... I need you... I want you to be mine...
Alberic... you...
Why... why won't anyone acknowledge me...
Why... when I'm trying so hard...
When this demon sword has made me so strong...
...The sword has stolen your heart.
Everyone... mocking me behind my back...
They... shunned me... so I killed them...
...Your eyes mock me... they look down on me...
And I believed you, at least, would understand...
...I'll kill you...
You're from the Empire, aren't you?
Yes, I am... And you?
I'm from the Forest of Reyforia, which the Empire invaded.
A forest can't do anyone any harm, so why does the Empire do such terrible things?
That... I don't know either...
I thought you might know something, but that uniform is just for show, isn't it...
You're the one from before...
I said something very rude to you then, and I'm truly sorry. I didn't know you were struggling...
No, it's all right. It's true that I couldn't stop my own country from changing...
No, I'm sure you tried. Let us keep working together so that peace returns to the world.
Hey! You're not planning to make trouble around here, are you?
The Empire's people are nothing but trouble. You're one of them too, right?
That's... But I haven't done anything...
That uniform is a symbol of terror...
Ah... um!
You're the one from Legrance...?
Yes, I'm Rudiere.
Um... I'm sorry! I said some awful things...
I don't mind at all. What you said was only natural.
My country has changed. And I couldn't do anything about it...
That's not true! You kept fighting, even on your own! I... I think that's admirable...
Serenis... no, you dreadful witch... You were the root of all this.
The Kreutzfelds, father and son, were your doing too...
Serenis...!
Oh my, Alberic's favorite hero. I never thought you'd make it this far.
It stopped? Serenis's movements?!
Don't tell me... Serenis is using you too?
Why do you fight? There's no need to throw your life away, is there?
